keyVerseDR: "If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me." (Mt 16:24)

level1.title: Carry Your Cross
level1.story: Jesus said He would suffer and die, then rise again. Peter said, "No!" Jesus said, "Take up your cross and follow Me."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus ask us to carry?
What hard thing can you do with love?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me carry my cross. Amen.

activity.title: I will follow Jesus
activity.intro: Put your thumbprint on the cross as a promise.
activity.label: I will carry my cross

level2.title: Take Up Your Cross
level2.story: Jesus began to tell His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, suffer, be killed, and rise on the third day. Peter took Him aside and said, "God forbid, Lord! This shall never happen to You." Jesus said Peter was thinking as people think, not as God thinks. He said, "If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me." Whoever loses his life for Jesus' sake will find it.
level2.keyLine: Take up his cross, and follow me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Peter not want Jesus to suffer?
What does 'deny yourself' look like for you?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I will follow You, even to the cross. Amen.

activity.title: Deny yourself
activity.intro: Weigh it up: what habit can I drop to follow Jesus better?

art.mainBrief: Jesus walking ahead carrying a cross; disciples follow
